summary: Collects the special-purpose IPv6 addresses defined across many other RFCs into one list, such as loopback, unspecified, and documentation ranges. It is meant as a checklist of prefixes that should not be routed on the public Internet, useful when writing filters. It is informational and was replaced by RFC 6890.

eli5.summary: Some phone numbers are for practice or testing only, never real people. This is a list of internet addresses like that, so nobody uses them by mistake.

questions: which ipv6 prefixes should be filtered
